description: Small author-written synthetic diagnostic set, frozen before first live evaluation. Not a population sample or a coding-host benchmark.

candidates.name: Patch review
candidates.description: Inspect a proposed source-code diff for correctness bugs and regressions. Read-only review; does not implement changes, draw charts or write release notes.

candidates.name: Godot save recovery
candidates.description: Diagnose and repair Godot save serialization and reload defects using a copy of a save. Verify inventory persistence across restart. Does not modify real player saves without authorization.

candidates.name: CSV charts
candidates.description: Create a standalone chart from tabular CSV measurements, with labelled axes and an exportable figure. Does not review source code or repair databases.

candidates.name: Release notes
candidates.description: Draft user-facing release notes from supplied verified changes and test evidence. Clearly label limitations. Does not implement features or claim tests were run without evidence.
